context: M26 o7. (Teddy.) 02:40. Fire bells. Engines on W 31st. Tenants on the sidewalk in robes. No smoke.

lines.speaker: npc.firefighter
lines.text: Who pulled the box? Somebody pulled the box. Building's fine.

lines.speaker: char.odessa_pruitt
lines.text: Everybody out. Slowly. Mr. Ostrow, your teeth are in your pocket.

lines.speaker: char.gus_wilkie
lines.text: It wasn't me! I left the door locked! I locked it, Teddy!

lines.speaker: char.gus_wilkie
lines.text: I left the service door open. Prentiss paid me. I'm sorry. I'm sorry.

lines.speaker: char.delphine_moore
lines.text: (Payphone) Teddy. Your firebug's walking east on Thirty-First. Two cans. Tan jacket.

lines.speaker: char.teddy_arce
lines.text: Got him. Delphine, stay with the tenants. I'll find who's paying.
